Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

Hanno Children's Library will be temporarily closed for facility repairs during the following period.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure Period (all day)】

December 4, 2026 (Reiwa 8) through January 15, 2027 (Reiwa 9)

【What this means】

• You cannot browse materials, borrow books, or return books at Hanno Children's Library during this time.

• If you have a reserved item scheduled to be picked up at Hanno Children's Library, please pick it up at Hanno City Library instead.

• The book drop box will remain available throughout the closure period.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
summary: 📚 Hanno Children's Library Temporary Closure (December 4, 2026 – January 15, 2027)
